title: Forgetting normalization of native open tensor
statement: For the native open tensor data, supplied localized comparison maps and the recorded presentation satisfying the comparison equalities, Nonempty (OpenTensorForgetData ...).

proof.text: Import the existing native inverse-unit normalization theorem for the supplied presentation. Its statement is unchanged.
Obtain only the ordinary restriction/tensor isomorphism and its native forget square from the restriction comparison lemma. Its hypotheses omit extension and gamma normalization.

Construct the ordinary inverse open tensor natural transformation as the adjunct of TA′(unit,id) followed by rho′ inverse. Prove naturality using restriction naturality and unit naturality. The open unit is invertible, as is the counit at the ambient tensor by the support lemma, so this adjunct is invertible. Its inverse defines gamma′, and Equiv.apply_symm_apply proves the required inverse-unit formula.

Prove that the exact localization squares for extension and restriction preserve the specified adjunction unit. On complexes this is the degreewise identity s.unit_forget. Cancel the standard exact-functor factors and use the localization natural-transformation extensionality theorem to descend this equality.

Under this unit square the adjunction homEquiv commutes with forgetting. Apply injectivity of the ordinary homEquiv to the inverse gamma square; native and ordinary inverse-unit formulas reduce it to the restriction forget square and naturality of the tensor comparison. Invert the gamma square by cancelling the isomorphisms. Package rho′, gamma′, both normalizations and this compatibility in OpenTensorForgetData.

    (c : OpenTensorPresentation (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l U) (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l Z))
    (_hc :
      HEq c.E (extensionByZero k₀ l j) ∧ HEq c.R (upperStar k₀ l j) ∧
      HEq c.SA (nativeOpenSheafTensor k₀ l U) ∧ HEq c.SB (nativeOpenSheafTensor k₀ l Z) ∧
      HEq c.TA (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l U) ∧ HEq c.TB (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l Z) ∧
